description: AGSC-11-16 as amended at rc.6: the `mcp` surface declares the revision its transport actually speaks, and revision 2026-07-28 is the target rather than a pin, because the released reference transport speaks 2025-11-25 and a rule may not pin a value no conforming implementation can produce. The case is bnd-0031's with one input added, `mcp_revision`, the revision the node's transport speaks: the declaration ECHOES it and has the protocol's `YYYY-MM-DD` shape, exactly as the WebMCP date has since rc.5. Everything else is bnd-0031's: every served surface declared with its id, external version and access class derived from what is emitted, the built-in access classes fixed (llms-txt and chunks none, webmcp and mcp consent), the three WebMCP annotation hints per tool (AGSC-11-18) and the MCP extension identifier advertised in the extensions map (AGSC-11-18). The expectation member mcp_extensions names the extension IDENTIFIERS the node advertises; the per-identifier settings object is bnd-0035's.
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6 as the successor of bnd-0031; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
